name: Heaven & Hell ~Nagutte Okasu! Saikyou Ryona Battle!~
original_name: ヘブンズ＆ヘル～殴って犯す！最凶リョナバトル！～
source:
In this life, there is one simple truth... Strength, skill, no matter how extraordinary is worthless if it's not applied. And no amount of talent or strength will outmatch a gun. That reality was drilled into my brain like a trauma when the woman I loved was attacked. That day forward, I lost my reason to live, burdened by a cloak of desire and frustration, rolling with and fighting street thugs.
That's how I came to know a particular strange bastard. 
"If there were a place that let you do anything you wanted......" he said, "if you could HAVE anything you wanted, would you go?" 
...... Huh? The guy must be nuts. First of all my desire was impossible to be fulfilled. And where in Japan could someone unleash pure rage without getting arrested or worse?
I scoffed, but the guy's face was unchanging. 
"If you're strong enough, anything goes. Would you go?" he invited.
...... Yeah. I'd go. What did I have to lose? If it was a trick or something I'd just wallop the bastard. So I followed him......
To an alternate dimension. Hosted by demons. A grand arena called "Heavens & Hell". A lawless battleground of beautiful women.
"Purge your desire! To the winner, any wish is bestowed!"
If I could actually have what I wanted......
Pure, unfiltered violence! I'm going to fuck shit up! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE173481.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
人这一生，有一个简单的道理……力量、技巧，无论多么非凡，如果不运用，都是一文不值。再多的天赋或力量也无法与枪匹敌。当我所爱的女人遭到袭击时，这个现实就像创伤一样钻进了我的大脑。那天之后，我失去了生存的理由，被欲望和挫败感所困扰，与街头暴徒打斗。
就这样我认识了一个特别奇怪的混蛋。
“如果有一个地方可以让你做任何你想做的事情……”他说，“如果你可以拥有任何你想要的东西，你会去吗？” 
……嗯？那家伙一定是疯了。首先我的愿望是不可能实现的。在日本哪里有人可以释放纯粹的愤怒而不会被捕或更糟？
我嗤之以鼻，但那家伙的脸色没有任何变化。
“如果你足够强大，什么都可以。你愿意去吗？”他邀请。
…… 是的。我会去。我必须失去什么？如果这是一个诡计或者什么我就会狠狠地揍那个混蛋。于是我就跟着他了……
到另一个维度。由恶魔主持。一个名为“天堂与地狱”的宏伟竞技场。美女的无法无天的战场。
“净化你的欲望！胜利者，任何愿望都可以实现！”
如果我真的能得到我想要的东西就好了……
纯粹的、未经过滤的暴力！我他妈的要完蛋了！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE173481.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
